name: single leg squat with support (pistol)
description: A pistol squat where you hold onto a support to help with balance. It builds single-leg strength and control on the way to an unassisted pistol.
instructions: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands.
Lift one leg out in front of you and balance on the other.
Sit your hips back and bend your knee, lowering as far as you can control.
Keep your heel down and your knee tracking over your toes.
Press through your foot to stand, using the support only as needed, then switch legs.
